name: Green antelopehorn milkweed
desc: Green antelopehorn milkweed (Asclepias viridiflora): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 23 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias viridiflora; also known as green comet milkweed, green-flower milkweed, and green milkweed; is a species of milkweed (Asclepias).
